markdown.markdown: profile Hi — I'm a **Senior Technical Lead (Statistical Programming) and Clinical Data Scientist** with **close to a decade** of experience in clinical data analysis, CDISC standards, and statistical programming. I currently work at **Ephicacy Lifescience Analytics** and am pursuing my **PhD in Statistics** at Amity University. My work sits at the intersection of statistics, software engineering, and clinical research — building tools that help pharmaceutical teams analyze, visualize, and report clinical trial data with greater speed and accuracy. --- ## Professional Experience ::: {.cv-role} [**Senior Technical Lead – Statistical Programming**]{.role-title} [[Ephicacy Lifescience Analytics](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ephicacy-lifescience-analytics/) · Full-time · Trivandrum, Kerala, India (Remote)]{.role-company} [March 2026 – Present]{.role-date} - Lead statistical programming deliverables for clinical trials, ensuring CDISC (SDTM/ADaM) and regulatory compliance - Drive R-based automation of clinical reporting workflows and mentor programming teams ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Senior Statistical Programmer**]{.role-title} [IQVIA RDS Pvt. Ltd. · India]{.role-company} [July 2024 – March 2026]{.role-date} - Lead R package development and validation for clinical trial reporting workflows - Maintain and expand an R package catalogue for reproducibility and compliance - Drive TLG (Tables, Listings, Graphs) generation using validated R packages in line with CDISC and regulatory standards ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Associate Lead – Clinical Data Analytics**]{.role-title} [Genpro Research Pvt. Ltd. · Trivandrum, Kerala]{.role-company} [April 2023 – July 2024]{.role-date} - Led development of R Shiny dashboards for clinical data visualization and TFL reporting automation - Architected and maintained R packages for end-to-end SDTM, ADaM, and TFL creation - Mentored and trained analysts in open-source clinical reporting tools ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Part-Time Lecturer in Biostatistics**]{.role-title} [Gulf Medical University · UAE (Remote)]{.role-company} [January 2022 – August 2023]{.role-date} - Taught Biostatistics to medical students covering descriptive statistics, inferential methods, clinical trial design, and data interpretation ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Data Analyst Level II**]{.role-title} [Genpro Research Pvt. Ltd. · Trivandrum, Kerala]{.role-company} [April 2022 – March 2023]{.role-date} - Developed R Shiny dashboards for clinical data visualization and interactive trial reporting - Built R packages to automate ADaM dataset generation and SAS date conversion within R environments ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Statistical Programmer Level I**]{.role-title} [Genpro Research Pvt. Ltd. · Trivandrum, Kerala]{.role-company} [September 2019 – March 2022]{.role-date} - Converted clinical study datasets to CDISC/SDTM standards across multiple therapeutic areas - Developed SAS macro programs for ADaM dataset generation and TFL creation - Generated XML outputs for FDA regulatory submissions ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Data Scientist**]{.role-title} [Menerva Software · Cochin, Kerala]{.role-company} [February 2019 – November 2019]{.role-date} - Developed Medical Entity Recognition (Bio-NER) models for insurance data processing - Researched cryptocurrency value forecasting for Ethereum tokens using time-series models ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Data Scientist / ML Developer**]{.role-title} [Suyati Technologies · Cochin, Kerala]{.role-company} [June 2018 – January 2019]{.role-date} - Developed machine learning models for Pricing Intelligence, Sales Forecasting, and CLTV prediction - Delivered a webinar on 'Buy Till You Die model for CLTV' to industry professionals ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Business Analyst**]{.role-title} [BRIDGEi2i Analytics Solutions Pvt. Ltd. · Bangalore]{.role-company} [May 2017 – May 2018]{.role-date} - Performed Tweet Sentiment Analysis using NLP techniques - Contributed to Chatbot development using NLU frameworks - Built regression, classification, and dynamic pricing models ::: --- ## Technical Skills statistical programming R (Advanced) Python (Advanced) SAS Base SAS Macros SAS/STAT R Package Development R Shiny R Markdown clinical & regulatory CDISC Standards SDTM ADaM TLG / TFL Programming Define.xml FDA XML Submissions CSR & SAP Automation pharmaverse tools admiral sdtm.oak xportr metacore rtables data visualization Tableau Power BI ggplot2 Plotly Matplotlib machine learning & ai Supervised Learning Unsupervised Learning NLP / NER CNNs / RNNs Generative AI CLTV Models --- ## Education - **PhD in Statistics** (In Progress) — Amity University, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh · 2024–Present - **Diploma in Project Management** — Oxford Home Study Center (OHSC), Oxford · 2023 - **M.Sc. in Statistics** — Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kerala · 2015–2017 - **B.Sc. in Statistics** — Christian College, Kattakada, University of Kerala · 2012–2015 --- ## Certifications ::: {.cert-item} **SAS Certified Base Programmer** · SAS Institute · 2021 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **IBM Data Science Professional Certification** · IBM · 2020 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Data Science Specialization (R)** · Johns Hopkins University / Coursera · 2022 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Google Data Analytics Professional Certification** · Google · 2023 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Google Project Management Professional Certification** · Google · 2024 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Career Essentials in Data Analysis** · Microsoft & LinkedIn · 2023 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **SDTM001: Introduction to Study Data Tabulation Model** · CDISC ::: --- ## Professional Affiliations Volunteer – CDISC Open-Source Alliance (COSA) Volunteer – Kerala Police Cyberdome Life Member – Indian Society for Probability and Statistics --- ## Interests When I'm not building clinical pipelines or writing papers, I enjoy exploring the latest in Data Science and AI, solving complex statistical puzzles, community volunteering, and travel photography. --- ## Connect with Me [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/LinkedIn-0077B5?style=for-the-badge&logo=linkedin&logoColor=white)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/imaheshdivakaran/) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/itsmdivakaran) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Email-D13832?style=for-the-badge&logo=gmail&logoColor=white)](mailto:imaheshdivakaran@gmail.com)
